277118255.description:
Natural Brazilian Agate
Pink Dyed Geode Bookends
Vintage Era, Hand-Polished Faces
This pair of decorative bookends is crafted from natural agate geodes sourced from Brazil, featuring a vibrant dyed pink coloration that accentuates the stone's intricate concentric banding. The polished display faces contrast beautifully with the rugged, natural exterior, revealing crystalline druzy quartz centers that catch the light and showcase the unique geological history of each specimen.
Natural Brazilian agate with high-gloss polished faces and raw geode exteriors
Distinctive druzy crystalline centers with layered concentric growth patterns
Substantial weight for secure support of book collections on shelves or mantels
Original "Made in Brazil" label present on the base of one piece
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The polished surfaces are smooth and retain a bright, reflective finish. The natural rough edges show expected geological textures with no signs of post-production damage or significant chipping. Base retains original manufacturing and retail stickers. Natural variations in stone shape and color saturation are present between the two halves.
